# Getting help

This repository is an unused Mintlify starter template, so there is nothing here to support.
Here is where to go instead:

| You need help with... | Go here |
|---|---|
| Using DualMind Arena | The docs at [docs.dualmindlab.tech](https://docs.dualmindlab.tech) |
| A mistake or missing page in the docs | An issue in [dualmindlabs/arena-docs](https://github.com/dualmindlabs/arena-docs/issues/new/choose) |
| Your Arena account, signing in, or something broken in the Arena | Email [support@dualmindlab.tech](mailto:support@dualmindlab.tech) and include the email you signed up with |
| Partnerships, research or anything else | Email [hello@dualmindlab.tech](mailto:hello@dualmindlab.tech) or use the [contact page](https://dualmindlab.tech/contact) |
| Your data or privacy | Email [privacy@dualmindlab.tech](mailto:privacy@dualmindlab.tech) |
| A security problem | Do **not** open an issue. Follow the [security policy](SECURITY.md) |
| Mintlify itself | The [Mintlify docs](https://www.mintlify.com/docs) |
